lines.en: I bounce, one heavy hop at a time.
Each hop rocks the ground.
My crown is worn bright.
One bounce flattens a ring of grass.
I squash flat, then swell up.
I'm pushing my territory outward.
I leap, and shadow follows.

lines.zh: 我把前面的石头碾低了。
lines.en: I flatten the stone in my path.
I roll over the grass and it can't stand up again.
The water inside me sloshes.
I stand there, one great mass of jelly.
My body is full of debris.
My subjects are all around.
I'm not hungry. I want to grow.
I lift my head; the crown tilts.
I wait for someone to come near.
My rim ripples in rings.
This land is already mine.
Standing still is also waiting.

lines.zh: 我看不清你，你也看不清我。
lines.en: I can't see you clearly, and you can't see me.
I push my wet mark farther out.
I'm cool, and heavy.
I belch, and a little spills out.
I'm growing. Always growing.
They call me a king.

lines.zh: 我把一小块石头包了进去。
lines.en: I've swallowed a small stone.

lines.zh: 你在我脚边，就像颗石子。
lines.en: At my feet, you're a pebble.
Have you seen my crown?
You dare stand this close.

lines.zh: 你手里的剑，能砍开水吗？
lines.en: Can that sword cut water?
I'm no ordinary blob.
This place answers to me.
Let me see how long you last.

lines.zh: 你一退，地上的水就退了。
lines.en: Step back and the water recedes.

lines.zh: 你的影子快被我的盖住了。
lines.en: My shadow is about to swallow yours.
I'm growing. You can see it.

lines.zh: 你一个人站这儿，是来送死吗？
lines.en: Did you come here alone to die?
My crown is crooked. I don't care.
I dent, then swell back.
A gap opens in my rim.
I retreat half a meter; ripples spread.
That went into my body.
I shudder all over.
I don't cry out. I have no throat.
The debris inside scatters.

lines.zh: 我少了一整块，地上都是水。
lines.en: A whole piece of me is gone, water everywhere.
This will close quickly.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我的王冠打歪了。
lines.en: That knocked my crown crooked.
That sort of thing won't go into me.
Drop it in and it sinks.

lines.zh: 你举着的那点，塞不住我的缝。
lines.en: That morsel won't fill the gaps in me.
You want me to pause?
I want ground, not food.
Keep it. I'm not short.
I'm not picky, but I'm not tempted.

lines.zh: 这点东西，抵不上我一根手指。
lines.en: That's less than one of my fingers.

lines.zh: 你别拿这个当借口靠近。
lines.en: Don't use that as an excuse to come near.
Put it away before it gets wet.
You hit me and I dent.

lines.zh: 我弹回去，把你的脚陷进来。
lines.en: I bounce back and your foot sinks in.

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞在一堵水上。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting a wall of water.

lines.zh: 你撞进我，我送你弹回去。
lines.en: You crash into me, and I bounce you back.
I squashed flat, and you didn't hurt me.
My water is on the whole floor.

lines.zh: 你踩进来，我裹住了你的鞋。
lines.en: You stepped in and I've wrapped your boot.

lines.zh: 我慢慢鼓起来，把空间占了。
lines.en: I swell slowly and take the space.

lines.zh: 这一下，我也被自己震到了。
lines.en: That jolt reached even me.
Step back. I'm landing.
Another mass is nearby.

lines.zh: 两团水贴在一起，分不清了。
lines.en: Two blobs press together until we blur.
Then we split apart again.

lines.zh: 另一团在我旁边鼓起来。
lines.en: Another blob swells up beside me.
When we collide, the water sprays.
We push the border together.
Its crown is crooked.
Our territories touch.
Neither intends to yield.
Parted, each goes its own way.
I swallow it into my body.
It sinks slowly.
Too hard; it sticks inside.
The pearl glows inside me.
All the drops are mine.
My body has wrapped around it.
I can't be bothered to gather it.
Something is turning inside me.
I dissolve it slowly.
This haul is nothing.
You've crossed my border.
I press my whole mass toward you.
This one leaves no gap.
My subjects surround you.
The ground under you goes first.

lines.zh: 我把自己举高，再砸下去。
lines.en: I lift myself high, then slam down.

lines.zh: 你退到哪，我的边沿压到哪。
lines.en: Wherever you back away, my edge presses in.
The water on you is mine.

lines.zh: 我锁定了你脚下那块地。
lines.en: I've fixed on the ground beneath you.
I mean to take you in.
You're still inside my shadow.
This one will be heavy.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，墙也挡不住水。
lines.en: The wall won't stop water.
I close in from every side.

lines.zh: 最后一块干地，被我盖住了。
lines.en: I cover the last dry patch.

lines.zh: 我憋了很久，就等这一下。
lines.en: I've waited long for this one moment.
My rim has touched you.

lines.zh: 我的身体已经涨到极限。
lines.en: I'm swollen to my limit.
You can't outrun the water I'm made of.
From this moment it's over.
You jump; I jump.

lines.zh: 我的身体跟着你的方向。
lines.en: My mass follows your direction.
You're on high ground; I press up.

lines.zh: 我一次落地就靠近一截。
lines.en: Each landing brings me closer.
Water drips off you.
I stay under your feet.
Trees won't block me.

lines.zh: 我的边沿已经贴上你的脚。
lines.en: My rim is on your foot.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，地就湿一片。
lines.en: Every step you take wets the ground.
Your strength is fading.
I press lower.
You circle; I keep pressing.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把空地占满。
lines.en: Step by step, I fill the clearing.
I've ringed this clearing.
Only the middle is left to you.
A little closer and it closes.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸我听不见，可我看得见。
lines.en: I don't hear your breath, but I see it.
I've lowered my crown.

lines.zh: 你跑再久，也还在我的地上。
lines.en: Run all you like, you're still on my ground.
Nowhere left to step.
My whole mass crashes down.
The ground squeezes out a ring of water.
Half of you is wrapped.
My weight drags your feet.
You cut me open; I close again.
Water jets from my seams.
You fall back; my water follows.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的护甲进了水。
lines.en: Water has got into your armor.

lines.zh: 水灌进你的靴子，你滑了。
lines.en: Water fills your boots and you slip.
My subjects hit your flank.
I press you to your knees.
You're thrown back and roll twice.

lines.zh: 这一击让整片地都下沉。
lines.en: That one sinks the whole patch.
I raise my rim.
I swell up from the water's floor.
This land is mine from now on.
The crown appears first, then me.
I land and the grass goes flat.

lines.zh: 有人把王冠戴到了我头上。
lines.en: Someone has set the crown on my head.
The damp here suits me.
I swell slowly.
The small ones gather around me.
I press across a ditch.
Water spills over my rim.
I rise, tall.
I'm claiming this stretch first.
My body rumbles.
I set my crown straight.
My landing makes a dull thud.
I'm here. Make way.
I'm the largest of this brood.
I spread my shadow.

lines.zh: 这片林子的水都听我的。
lines.en: The water in this wood answers to me.
I'm waiting for a fight.

lines.zh: 火烤得我冒白气，我缩了。
lines.en: Fire boils steam off me; I shrink.
I land and spread very wide.
Water is where I'm comfortable.
The blast tears a great piece from me.
An arrow sinks and sticks inside.
Light burns inside me.
I've shrunk to half my size.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整团都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole mass shakes.
I break into water and fall.
